description:
The task involved explaining the architecture of `codx-api`, a Python FastAPI backend serving the `codx-junior` application.
The system is divided into two distinct modules with clear separation of concerns: `app` and `engine`.
The `app` module handles API routing, middleware configuration, background tasks, and Socket.IO real-time communication.
The `engine` module contains the core business logic, managing project lifecycles, session states, and high-level backend operations.
Together, they enable a scalable architecture where routes delegate computation to the engine while maintaining lightweight I/O handling.
